name: skip-before-projection
query: MATCH (n:CallSiteNode) WHERE n.id >= 0 RETURN CASE WHEN n.id=17 THEN substring('x','bad') ELSE n.id END AS x SKIP 1 LIMIT 1

name: skip-zero-projects-first
query: MATCH (n:CallSiteNode) WHERE n.id >= 0 RETURN CASE WHEN n.id=17 THEN substring('x','bad') ELSE n.id END AS x SKIP 0 LIMIT 1

name: skip-parameter-ignored
query: MATCH (n:CallSiteNode) WHERE n.id >= 0 RETURN n.id AS x SKIP $skip LIMIT 1

name: skip-throwing-expression-ignored
query: MATCH (n:CallSiteNode) WHERE n.id >= 0 RETURN n.id AS x SKIP substring('x','bad') LIMIT 1

name: skip-add-expression-ignored
query: MATCH (n:CallSiteNode) WHERE n.id >= 0 RETURN n.id AS x SKIP 1+1 LIMIT 1

name: skip-string-literal-converts-zero
query: MATCH (n:CallSiteNode) WHERE n.id >= 0 RETURN n.id AS x SKIP 'bad' LIMIT 1

name: skip-unary-negative-ignored
query: MATCH (n:CallSiteNode) WHERE n.id >= 0 RETURN n.id AS x SKIP -1 LIMIT 1

name: limit-zero-skips-everything
query: MATCH (n:CallSiteNode) WHERE n.id >= 0 RETURN substring('x','bad') AS x ORDER BY substring('x','bad') SKIP 1 LIMIT 0

name: negative-skip-with-zero-limit
query: MATCH (n:CallSiteNode) WHERE n.id >= 0 RETURN substring('x','bad') AS x SKIP -1 LIMIT 0

name: retained-overflow-fallback
query: MATCH (n:CallSiteNode) WHERE n.id >= 0 RETURN n.id AS x SKIP 2147483647 LIMIT 1

name: generic-stop-before-late-read
query: MATCH (n:CallSiteNode) WHERE n.id >= 0 RETURN n.id AS x LIMIT 1

name: order-consumes-late-read
query: MATCH (n:CallSiteNode) WHERE n.id >= 0 RETURN n.id AS x ORDER BY x LIMIT 1

name: order-projection-before-later-read
query: MATCH (n:CallSiteNode) WHERE n.id >= 0 RETURN substring('x','bad') AS x ORDER BY x LIMIT 1

name: unbounded-projects-before-later-read
query: MATCH (n:CallSiteNode) WHERE n.id >= 0 RETURN substring('x','bad') AS x

name: order-evaluates-discarded-rows
query: MATCH (n:CallSiteNode) WHERE n.id >= 0 RETURN n.id AS x ORDER BY CASE WHEN n.id=90 THEN substring('x','bad') ELSE 0 END LIMIT 1

name: order-ties-preserve-encounter
query: MATCH (n:CallSiteNode) WHERE n.id >= 0 RETURN n.id AS x ORDER BY 0 SKIP 1 LIMIT 2

name: order-source-property
query: MATCH (n:CallSiteNode) WHERE n.id >= 0 RETURN n.id AS x ORDER BY n.id DESC LIMIT 2

name: order-alias-shadow
query: MATCH (n:CallSiteNode) WHERE n.id >= 0 RETURN n.id AS n ORDER BY n.id LIMIT 2

name: distinct-skips-duplicate-order
query: MATCH (n:CallSiteNode) WHERE n.id >= 0 RETURN DISTINCT 1 AS x ORDER BY CASE WHEN n.id=17 THEN 0 ELSE substring('x','bad') END LIMIT 1

name: distinct-still-projects-duplicate
query: MATCH (n:CallSiteNode) WHERE n.id >= 0 RETURN DISTINCT CASE WHEN n.id=17 THEN 1 ELSE substring('x','bad') END AS x ORDER BY 0 LIMIT 1

name: distinct-eviction-rechecks-order
query: MATCH (n:CallSiteNode) WHERE n.id >= 0 RETURN DISTINCT CASE WHEN n.id IN [17,90] THEN 'A' ELSE 'B' END AS x ORDER BY CASE WHEN n.id=17 THEN 10 WHEN n.id=90 THEN substring('x','bad') ELSE 0 END LIMIT 1

name: distinct-order-duplicate-still-decodes
query: MATCH (n:CallSiteNode) WHERE n.id >= 0 RETURN DISTINCT 1 AS x ORDER BY 0 LIMIT 1

name: distinct-skip-scope-stop
query: MATCH (n:CallSiteNode) WHERE n.id >= 0 RETURN DISTINCT n.caller_name AS x SKIP 1 LIMIT 1

name: late-duplicate-provenance-order-skipped
query: MATCH (n:CallSiteNode) WHERE n.id=17 RETURN DISTINCT 1 AS x ORDER BY CASE WHEN n.graphId='a' THEN 0 ELSE substring('x','bad') END LIMIT 1

name: direct-skip
query: MATCH (n:CallSiteNode) WHERE n.caller_name CONTAINS 'other' RETURN n.id AS x SKIP 1 LIMIT 1

name: direct-order
query: MATCH (n:CallSiteNode) WHERE n.caller_name CONTAINS 'other' RETURN n.id AS x ORDER BY x DESC LIMIT 1

name: direct-order-throw
query: MATCH (n:CallSiteNode) WHERE n.caller_name CONTAINS 'other' RETURN n.id AS x ORDER BY substring(n.caller_name,'bad') LIMIT 1
